evidence.title: Revolutionize Your Designs with Our Interactive AI Studio

name: Revolutionize Your Designs with Our Interactive AI Studio
summary: Contra community post showing an AI background generator reworked into an interactive studio with Base44.
description: A Contra community post by Zaoui Sohaib that reimagines PRYZM, an AI background generator, as an interactive creative studio built with Base44 and no coding. It lists what was built — several creative builders (social media, portfolio, AI image mixing, a 3D logo builder), AI-generated animated backgrounds and custom cursor, sharing, remixing and export as image or video — followed by community comments and related posts.
